prompt:
Create one finished Cars24 blog cover image, 1000 x 650 final crop-safe composition, dark Cars24 theme. This version has NO visible text anywhere. Render background, pattern, and photo hero together as one composed creative.

Reference intent: Cars24 dark-theme composition with generous negative space on the left/top-left and a calm real photo hero lower-right/right side. Match Cars24 assisted-experience photography mood: natural light, real relatable South Asian people, calm professional service energy, candid and trustworthy.

Canvas: Cars24 Brand Blue #4736FE as the dominant full-bleed canvas, with a subtle same-hue vertical/ambient gradient for premium depth. The canvas must still read as bright Cars24 brand blue: not navy, not indigo, not black, not midnight blue, not dark violet, not dimmed AI-tech mode. Do not render the hex code as text.

Pattern: restrained white luminous Cars24 dot/wave field and small bokeh particles across the right and lower background, with some gentle flow through the open left area. Pattern should suggest controlled operational complexity, not chaos: soft route lines, small muted task nodes, faint particle structure, and calm signal paths. Keep enough clean negative space for possible external text placement later.

Photo hero: real photographic cutout, not illustration. Show a calm Cars24 operations/service team of three South Asian professionals maximum, wearing clean blue Cars24-style polos or workwear, gathered around one laptop/tablet or simple task board, focused and composed. They are the quiet reliable people bringing order to complexity. Natural skin tones, natural lighting, professional and reassuring expressions, not model-perfect. Render the team as a clean photographic cutout removed from its environment and placed directly on the Cars24 canvas, with a crisp visible white accent outline around the complete silhouette. Keep full heads, hands, laptop/tablet, and shoulders fully contained inside the safe zone; no cropping at edges.

Text and logo: absolutely no headline, no body copy, no letters, no numbers, no UI text, no captions, no Cars24 logo, no watermark.

Do not include: dramatic disaster scene, crash, fire, panic, emergency imagery, storm, war room cliche, dense dashboard, readable fake UI text, scattered warning icons, stock-photo office background, rectangular photo frame, embedded photo panel, illustration style, marble/statue subject, misspelled words, extra copy, watermark.
